EXAMPLE STANDARD SUBCONTRACT AGREEMENT (COMPANY BASELINE)
1. Definitions
1.1 "Main Contract" means the contract between the Employer and the Main Contractor for the Project.
1.2 "Subcontract Works" means the works described in the Scope of Work at Appendix A.
2. Order of Precedence
2.1 The documents forming the Subcontract shall be read in the following order of precedence: (a) the Subcontract Agreement; (b) the Particular Conditions; (c) the General Conditions; (d) the Scope of Work; (e) the Bill of Quantities.
3. Scope of Work
3.1 The Subcontractor shall execute and complete the Subcontract Works in accordance with the Subcontract and the Main Contract requirements applicable to the Subcontract Works.
4. Subcontract Price
4.1 The Subcontract Price is a re-measurable price based on the Bill of Quantities and the rates therein, which shall be fixed for the duration of the Subcontract.
5. Programme and Completion
5.1 The Subcontractor shall complete the Subcontract Works within 180 days from the Commencement Date and shall submit a detailed programme within 14 days of the Commencement Date.
6. Payment
6.1 The Subcontractor shall submit a monthly application for payment by the 25th day of each month.
6.2 The Main Contractor shall certify and pay the amount due within 30 days of receipt of a valid application for payment.
7. Advance Payment
7.1 An advance payment of 10% of the Subcontract Price shall be paid against an advance payment guarantee and recovered by deduction of 10% from each interim payment.
8. Retention
8.1 Retention of 10% shall be deducted from each interim payment up to a maximum of 5% of the Subcontract Price. Half shall be released at completion and the balance on expiry of the Defects Liability Period.
9. Performance Bond
9.1 The Subcontractor shall provide an unconditional performance bond of 10% of the Subcontract Price from a UAE bank acceptable to the Main Contractor, valid until completion of the Defects Liability Period.
10. Insurance
10.1 The Subcontractor shall maintain workmen's compensation insurance and third party liability insurance with a limit of not less than AED 5,000,000 per occurrence.
11. Variations
11.1 No variation shall be valued unless instructed in writing by the Main Contractor. Variations shall be valued using the rates in the Bill of Quantities where applicable.
12. Claims and Notices
12.1 The Subcontractor shall give notice of any claim within 14 days of becoming aware of the event or circumstance giving rise to the claim.
13. Extension of Time
13.1 The Subcontractor shall be entitled to an extension of time for delay caused by the Main Contractor or a Variation, provided notice is given within 14 days of the delay event.
14. Delay Damages
14.1 If the Subcontractor fails to complete the Subcontract Works by the Completion Date it shall pay delay damages at 0.1% of the Subcontract Price per day of delay up to a maximum of 10% of the Subcontract Price.
15. Liability and Indemnity
15.1 The Subcontractor shall indemnify the Main Contractor against all claims, losses and liabilities arising from the Subcontract Works.
16. Defects Liability
16.1 The Defects Liability Period shall be 12 months from the date of completion of the Main Contract works.
17. Termination
17.1 The Main Contractor may terminate the Subcontract by 7 days notice if the Subcontractor fails to remedy a material breach within 14 days of notice.
18. Final Account
18.1 The Subcontractor shall submit its final account within 56 days after completion.
19. Disputes
19.1 Disputes shall be referred to arbitration under the Abu Dhabi International Arbitration Centre rules, seated in Abu Dhabi.
20. Governing Law
20.1 This Subcontract shall be governed by the laws of the Emirate of Abu Dhabi and the federal laws of the UAE.

EXAMPLE SUBCONTRACTOR PROPOSED AGREEMENT (MARK-UP RECEIVED)
1. Definitions
1.1 "Main Contract" means the contract between the Employer and the Main Contractor for the Project.
1.2 "Subcontract Works" means the works described in the Scope of Work at Appendix A.
2. Order of Precedence
2.1 The documents forming the Subcontract shall be read in the following order of precedence: (a) the Subcontract Agreement; (b) the Particular Conditions; (c) the General Conditions; (d) the Scope of Work; (e) the Bill of Quantities.
3. Scope of Work
3.1 The Subcontractor shall execute and complete the Subcontract Works in accordance with the Subcontract and the Main Contract requirements applicable to the Subcontract Works.
4. Subcontract Price
4.1 The Subcontract Price is a re-measurable price based on the Bill of Quantities and the rates therein, which shall be fixed for the duration of the Subcontract.
5. Programme and Completion
5.1 The Subcontractor shall complete the Subcontract Works within 210 days from the Commencement Date and shall submit a detailed programme within 14 days of the Commencement Date.
6. Payment
6.1 The Subcontractor shall submit a monthly application for payment by the 25th day of each month.
6.2 The Main Contractor shall certify and pay the amount due within 60 days of receipt of a valid application for payment, subject to the Main Contractor having received payment from the Employer.
7. Advance Payment
7.1 An advance payment of 20% of the Subcontract Price shall be paid against an advance payment guarantee and recovered by deduction of 10% from each interim payment.
8. Retention
8.1 Retention of 5% shall be deducted from each interim payment up to a maximum of 5% of the Subcontract Price. Half shall be released at completion and the balance on expiry of the Defects Liability Period.
10. Insurance
10.1 The Subcontractor shall maintain workmen's compensation insurance and third party liability insurance with a limit of not less than AED 5,000,000 per occurrence.
11. Variations
11.1 No variation shall be valued unless instructed in writing by the Main Contractor. Variations shall be valued using the rates in the Bill of Quantities where applicable.
12. Claims and Notices
12.1 The Subcontractor shall give notice of any claim within 28 days of becoming aware of the event or circumstance giving rise to the claim.
13. Extension of Time
13.1 The Subcontractor shall be entitled to an extension of time for delay caused by the Main Contractor or a Variation, provided notice is given within 14 days of the delay event.
14. Delay Damages
14.1 If the Subcontractor fails to complete the Subcontract Works by the Completion Date it shall pay delay damages at 0.1% of the Subcontract Price per day of delay up to a maximum of 10% of the Subcontract Price.
15. Liability and Indemnity
15.1 The Subcontractor shall indemnify the Main Contractor against all claims, losses and liabilities arising from the Subcontract Works.
15.2 Limitation of Liability
The Subcontractor shall not be liable for any indirect or consequential loss, and the Subcontractor's aggregate liability under the Subcontract shall not exceed 20% of the Subcontract Price.
16. Defects Liability
16.1 The Defects Liability Period shall be 12 months from the date of completion of the Subcontract Works.
17. Termination
17.1 The Main Contractor may terminate the Subcontract by 7 days notice if the Subcontractor fails to remedy a material breach within 14 days of notice.
18. Final Account
18.1 The Subcontractor shall submit its final account within 56 days after completion.
19. Disputes
19.1 Disputes shall be referred to arbitration under the Abu Dhabi International Arbitration Centre rules, seated in Abu Dhabi.
20. Governing Law
20.1 This Subcontract shall be governed by the laws of the Emirate of Abu Dhabi and the federal laws of the UAE.
21. Particular Conditions
21.1 Delay Damages: notwithstanding any other provision, delay damages shall be 0.05% of the Subcontract Price per day of delay.

EXAMPLE MAIN CONTRACT EXTRACT (EMPLOYER / MAIN CONTRACTOR)
1. Order of Precedence
1.1 The Contract documents shall be read in the following order of precedence: (a) the Contract Agreement; (b) the Particular Conditions; (c) the General Conditions; (d) the Specification.
2. Claims
2.1 The Contractor shall give notice of any claim within 28 days of becoming aware of the event, failing which the Contractor shall not be entitled to any additional payment or extension of time.
3. Extension of Time
3.1 The Contractor shall give notice of a delay event within 28 days and shall be entitled to an extension of time for Employer delay.
4. Delay Damages
4.1 Delay damages shall be 0.1% of the Contract Price per day up to a maximum of 10% of the Contract Price.
5. Defects Notification Period
5.1 The Defects Notification Period shall be 24 months from the date of taking over.
6. Payment
6.1 The Employer shall pay the Contractor within 56 days of the Contractor's statement.
7. Insurance
7.1 The Contractor shall effect contractor's all risk insurance and third party liability insurance covering the Works.
8. Quality
8.1 The Contractor shall implement a quality management system and submit inspection and test plans.
9. Health and Safety
9.1 The Contractor shall comply with the HSE requirements of the Employer and applicable authorities.
10. Testing
10.1 The Contractor shall carry out tests on completion in accordance with the Specification.

scores.method: Overall alignment = average over baseline clauses of a status weight (Matched 1.00, Partially matched 0.75, Modified 0.40, Requires review 0.25, Conflicting 0, Missing 0). Clause alignment = baseline clauses with identical wording ÷ baseline clauses. Matching confidence = mean clause-pair match score (0.62 × content-word cosine similarity + 0.20 × title similarity + 0.08 × same clause number + 0.10 × same topic). Extraction confidence = pages with an extractable text layer (or OCR result) ÷ total pages. These scores measure textual alignment with the selected baseline only; they are not a statement of legal enforceability.
